verdict.rationale: The ecosystem is evidently live, but the evidence only covers third-party tools and routers. Docs say DeepSeek can serve as the backend for Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode, and for any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible software. Community posts show it being used via OpenRouter and run locally on accessible open weights. Missing for 10: curated community lists, evidence of active third-party maintainers, and independent coverage of the breadth of community integrations.
